label: Segmented Bars
description: Bars built from stacked blocks (like an LED level meter) over a faint full-height track, with a plan line.
howTo: Bind `xAxis.data` to the categories, `series[0].data` to the values and `series[2].data` to the plan line.
The blocks are a `pictorialBar` with `symbol: "rect"`, `symbolRepeat: true`, `symbolSize: [width, blockHeight]` and `symbolMargin` as the gap: change those to resize the segments.
The track is `series[1]`: the same blocks at low opacity, every value set to the axis maximum. Bind its values and `yAxis.max` together if the scale changes.

label: Hill Bars
description: Overlapping smooth peaks instead of rectangles, each in its own colour with the value on top.
howTo: Bind `xAxis.data` to the names and `series[0].data` to the values (plain numbers, or `{value, itemStyle: {color}}` to colour one peak).
The peak is a custom `symbol` path; `barCategoryGap: "-60%"` makes neighbours overlap. Use a less negative gap for more categories.
`colorBy: "data"` takes one theme colour per bar.

label: Tank Levels
description: Rounded tank outlines filled from the bottom to the level value, with the percentage above the liquid.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data` to the levels (0–100) and `xAxis.data` to the tank names.

Two series draw the same shape: `series[1]` is the empty tank (always 100), `series[0]` the liquid, cut off at its value by `symbolClip: true`. `symbolBoundingData: 100` tells both what a full tank is.
For a low-level colour give a data item its own style: `{"value": 23, "itemStyle": {"color": "#e5484d"}}` (as on Tank 4), e.g. from a script transform.
For levels in engineering units change `yAxis.max`, `symbolBoundingData`, the track values and `label.formatter` together.
